reviews.comment: Professor Laporte was an amazing teacher! Very easy class and the content and activities were fun as well. Only 12 classes a year so attendance is mandatory but the class is fun so it goes by quickly.

I really enjoyed this class and the professor. It's a fun class that will make you think about yourself a lot and it isn't too challenging. Laporte is hilarious and has tons of energy that makes the class great.

She cares about her students so much and it shows. Her class is not hard and is an easy A, but  you can get some really good things out of this class if you give it the chance. I learned so much about myself and had an amazing time in this class. I thought this would be a class I would hate going to once a week but I ended up being so excited to go

Best part about this class is that it is only one day a week! Prior to each class, there is a short reading, quiz, and some sort of challenge that you have to do. Overall, a pretty easy class that requires at most 2 hours per week. Prof. Laporte is good but does expect participation in class. Class may require some public speaking...
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Super easy, fun and informative. 205 really opened my eyes to new cultures and redefined the way I thought of things. Dr. Laporte is super fun and the classes are very engaging (and only once a week lol). 3 assignments a week and an exit ticket from the weekly class are how ur graded. just put in effort and its an easy A!

The easiest cultural discourse class you could take. You only meet once a week with two homework's due at the start of each class. It would only take me an hour or two to complete and if you follow the rubric, you will get full points every time. The content is def important for some people to learn, but for me I found it boring and common sense.

Dr Laporte is an absolutely amazing professor. She wants you to succeed and makes the class really easy excel in. You learn so much valuable information as well and the class is honestly fun. It's like maybe an hour of homework per week, no exams, just mandatory attendance to only one class a week! Love her, best prof I've had at TAMU

Mrs. Laporte cares very much about her class and her students. She usually gives 3 assignments a week which include 1 reading, 1 knowledge check, and 1 challenge (there's also options for the challenge that you get to choose). Attendance is also mandatory, and there are graded exit tickets every class. But there's only 1 class a week so it's easy.

Amazing class that really opened my eyes to different cultures around the world and was really discussion based which was nice. In addition she's extremely kind and understanding so I would really recommend this course.

Extremely enjoyable class, I took her for 210 and 222 in my last semester and I am very glad I did. I believe her classes allow us to further develop our soft skills and become curious about the world around us.
She has a very free way of thinking which I adore, what you put into the class is what you will get out.
Class is super easy- just weekly assignments. Would def take again. Prof is fine, but she'll get upset if you're not participating, and she says some weird things. No exams, super easy work

I recommend taking Professor Laporte class. Its super easy, no test or quizzes. Just weekly assignments that does involve lots of writing and reading,but,can be done in one day. There is another review about her being condescending which i can see. I am a liberal and Christian,so there are times where i feel she isn't as understanding as she says.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Amazing!!! she's so knowledgeable about the world, and genuinely makes the classroom a fun & interactive learning environment. She's easy to talk to (love her Aussie accent) & will have deep and meaningful conversations about topics in class. HW(discussions and "challenges") due before class starts- highly recommend!!! one of my favorite profs

I LOVE LAPORTE. Hands down the best professor I've ever taken. Her class is ridiculously easy, it's practically impossible to fail. No exams, no quizzes, and the homework is minimal. We met ONCE a week and the majority of the class was listening to her teach and yapping away with peers about whatever the topic we were discussing was.

Was an interesting teacher, I liked her a lot but her classes felt very repetitive and boring. It's easy to get an A but only if you participate in the reading and writings. Consisted of reading a 2-5 page paper then writing a 500 word essay every week. There are no exams so if you don't do a weekly assignment you could drop down a letter grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Easiest class ever. No exams nor projects. Show up because attendance matters and class meets once per week (still worth 3 credit hours). Do the work and spend some time each week doing it and you'll be able to skip the last two, longer assignments.

I loved this class and Professor Laporte. I took this class for my CD credit, but I learned so much. Professor Laporte's lectures were interesting, engaging, and allowed me to see the different cultural perspectives of the world. There were no exams! We had weekly HW that required thinking and creativity, but they were easy & fun. Take this class!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS CLASS! other than Dino world, this class is a 10/10. If you are looking for something with NO tests, homework can be done day of class, and you only have to meet once a week then this is the class for you! She is so sweet and understating and her lectures are awesome! I would defo take this class again so don't second guess taking it!

Absolutely love professor Laporte! She made class so much fun, took it for my cultural discourse credit and it turned into being my favorite class I've ever taken. No exams! She made lecture so engaging and the weekly homeworks were so fun to do. Not only learned so much about myself but about the world as well. Take her if you have the chance to!!

I truly think this course should be required of all TAMU students. She is caring, an interesting lecturer, and doesn't give exams or quizzes. The weekly homework isn't bad, but it definitely requires some thought and introspection. As long as you do the work she asks, you will easily get an A. Overall a super interesting class, and I learned a ton!

Laporte is a gift to this university. Took ANTH 222 for a cultural discourse credit, and it was a nice hybrid class that I actually ended up looking forward to every week. She is so sweet and the material was actually interesting and encouraged self-reflection. No exams, quizzes, or textbooks.
LAPORTE IS AMAZING!!!! She is so caring and so much FUN. I adored being in her class. If you are looking for a cultural discourse, DO THIS!!

Catharina was by far my favorite professor I have had so far in college. Her lectures were always super interesting and thought-provoking, and she genuinely cared about all of her students. She also does not give out any exams, at least in ANTH222 which was amazing.

Great lecturer and makes the course really engaging. Assignments are very straightforward and have a clear rubric to get an A on every submission. Attendance is required, but classes are short and fairly interesting. We had zero exams nor any tests/quizzes throughout the semester.

Overall, not a bad teacher for this class if you need a cultural discourse credit. It was pass/fail, so your grade didn't matter that much, but I don't think it will be pass/fail anymore. With that being said, it could be an easy A if you put in a little effort and go to class. Its busy work but none of the assignments take too long.

Lots of work for this class. The grades were taken pass/fail so the work felt like busy work. Work every week and attendance mandatory. I do not care much for sociology but professor Laporte made the lectures and activities engaging. You have to go to class or you will fail, so go to class. Very good prof, material/content not so much.

Such a great professor and easy class. Laporte knows what she is talking about and is very passionate about it. Found many topics interesting. You meet once a week to discuss content with your classmates. There are no exams just weekly discussions and readings which are easy. I would take this class if you are looking for a chill/laid back class!!

Professor Laporte cares about her students and creates an effective learning environment. This class is an easy A and is not stressful at all. Class meets once a week to discuss the content and there are no exams! Her lectures were fun and engaging as well!

Laporte was a wonderful professor. She gives no tests, but there are challenges and discussions due each week. She gives extra credit up to a 106 though, so an A is very doable. Her lectures are fun and enjoyable, and they expanded my perspective on life in many ways. The only thing is you can't really skip class bc she does graded exit tickets.

Dr. Laporte is an amazing prof! Class was very informative with well structured assignment plans, clear requirements, and no busy work. I genuinely feel that everything done in class furthered my understanding of the material. Catharina created a welcoming learning environment and I highly recommend any course taught by her. No exams, either!

LOVE Catharina and her TA Bethany. This class was very easy, but she is making it a little tougher next semester. There are no exams, so I could actually spend time engaging in the lectures instead of stressing. Her lectures rely on participation, but she makes it a comfortable space to share opinions. Take her!

I took this class as an elective (I'm not an ANTH major) and really enjoyed it! We only had class once a week, and they were always pretty interesting. We did groupwork and role playing sometimes. You have a weekly module task and biweekly journal entry, so it's pretty easy to keep up with. If you just put in a little effort, you'll get an A.

I wouldn't call it an "easy" A, but keeping up wasn't difficult. No exams, no textbook. Just show up to class and keep up with the weekly writing assignments and you'll be fine. Her lectures are really interesting and she gets the class to discuss and participate in really cool ways. One of my favorite classes I've ever taken.

Catharina (she requests to be on 1st name basis) is an amazing prof. This class was great, I'm taking 410 with her next. No exams. 12 weekly discussion type posts (2 lowest are dropped), 5 journal entries (1 lowest dropped), you grade your participation with a total of 10 points for the semester. Committed to doing the work, you will get an A.
PLEASE take Dr. Laporte. She gives thought-provoking lectures once a week. There are no exams and she works in favor of the students and their grades. Such a great prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: No clear criteria for anything she wanted. Does not clarify any of the topics we covered; students had to do all the teaching. Toolkit project at the end of the semester is super confusing & she gives no help in trying to clear up confusion.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Laporte is very sweet and caring. Her class is very easy and you should be able to make an A no problem. The only complaint is mostly all work is graded by a T.A who is very inconsistent. The course is very heavy on homework and essays. However there is no exams or tests.
Do yourself a favor and sign up for this teacher.

Dr. Laporte was the BEST professor I have ever had at A&M. She is not your typical lecturer, a lot of the learning in this class is through group discussions over zoom. She did not grade attendance and she doesn't believe in EXAMS, there was NO EXAMS. If you do the assignments which were easy you will pass! Great professor. Very easy class!

Dr. Laporte is absolutely one of the best professors I've had. She is incredibly knowledgeable and insightful, as well as fun and engaging. She's pretty casual, and she likes to go by Catharina. She makes it a point to save her students money, so she provides all the resources you need. No textbook! She really makes you think hard for assignments.

From the start it's clear that Dr. Laporte truly cares about education and her performance as an instructor. She is an expert in what she teaches and a great human being overall. Although her class was an 8am, her personality and the interesting content made it worthwhile. Also, NO EXAMS!
The class is graded on reading notes, 2 group presentations, a few "quick task" homeworks, and a final project. Basically, do your homework and go to class and you'll be fine.

Laporte is one of my favorite professors at A&M, she makes sure all her textbooks are reasonably priced, advocates for project-based learning, and makes sure to always be available outside of class to help. Would recommend her to anyone!

Prof. Laporte knows how to challenge the minds of her students in order to open them up to different ideas. Her lectures are very participation heavy because they are all about how you and your culture relate to others and the world around you. Amazing prof, would take again.

By far my favorite class at A&M. I'm an engineering major so this was outside of my spectrum but she made this class very enjoyable. There are readings every day but they are really interesting. There's also no test in her class but there are a lot of research journals.

Dr. Laporte is seriously the BEST professor I have ever had at A&M. She is not your typical lecturer, a lot of the learning in this class is through group discussions. There is homework every week, and there is a research handout every other week that she assigns. She made this class very enjoyable, she is so full of joy,  wisdom and knowledge.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The was the first class in my entire Engineering degree that I really enjoyed!  There is a lot of discussion and activities.  This class makes you think about stuff that you don't normally get to think about--- eye opening --- take this class!

I wasn't sure about this class when we started --- seminar facilitation, can't just sit there, lots of participation and class discussions.... but it challenged me and now I think it's the best class I have ever taken.  Lots to think about!
It wasn't a blow off course.  I gained a lot more respect for the subject.... it was probably the most interesting class I took in my  undergrad.
Professor Laporte was Awesome
Awesome professor... this is not my major, but I thought about switching after her class. Real world applicable content and really made me think.

She is very funny, yet explanatory. After her class, I gained a lot more respect for this subject, not to mention interest. She does not give exams, AT ALL. She only assigns Research Papers and Reflection Journals which are not time consuming in the least. She is very inconsistent on grading though, but offers help.
